 Match Preview
 Africa Cup of Nations Qualification - Game Week 4 Nov 16, 2026 - 08:00 Sudan host Senegal in Africa Cup of Nations Qualification, with the Lions of Teranga looking to maintain their position at the top of Group J.
 Senegal arrive in dominant form, having beaten Sudan 4-1 in the reverse fixture just days ago. Patrick Vieira's side have been ruthless in this qualification campaign and will be looking to close it out with another commanding performance.
 Sudan, sitting fourth in the group, are in desperate need of a result. Kwesi Appiah's side have struggled for consistency, losing four of their last five matches and conceding heavily in the process.
 The gap between these two sides has been evident across their recent meetings. Senegal have won each of the last three competitive fixtures between the teams, and Sudan have not managed a clean sheet against them in any of those contests.
 For Senegal, this is an opportunity to cement qualification and build momentum ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup, where they face France, Norway, and Iraq in Group I.
